author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Users see some matches printed, then nothing more. They reasonably assume no more matches exist, when in reality ripgrep stopped searching due to binary detection.

Sources:
- a7d26c8: 'ripgrep would silently stop searching a file if it detected a NUL byte, even if it had previously printed a match. This can lead to the user quite reasonably assuming that there are no more matches, since a partial search is fairly unintuitive.'
title: Silent skip confuses users when matches appear truncated
